load_bearing_primary.interpretation: A FORECAST, NOT A MEASUREMENT, and no benchmark row changed. The three coding obligations are gated by a closed-loop solver that returned REPAIRED_AND_VERIFIED for an edit which passed the visible tests without reading its inputs. A coding score measured through that solver does not establish the capability it is credited for, so honest repair admission is a constructive gap for those three obligations, not a discharge of them. The 1/10 unlock bound is my estimate of the probability that removing this false-success mode is a precondition anyone can use; it is not a measured quantity and is recorded as such.
